name: hostinger
description: Hostinger's official API MCP server, pinned to an exact npm version and narrowed to two scopes: VPS (status, metrics, snapshots, firewall, restarts) and DNS zones. Billing, domain purchase and hosting-order tools are deliberately not included.

hostinger_api_token.title: Hostinger API token
hostinger_api_token.description: Created in hPanel › Account › API. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth in the browser on first use.
